summary: @onereach/si-divider preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: @onereach/si-divider is published as a Vue divider UI component (module: lib/component.js) but adds a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs detects platform/arch, downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the bun binary, and uses it (via execFileSync) to run a sibling file math_init.js; if bun is already on PATH the download step is skipped and math_init.js is executed directly under it. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated bundle carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, a rotating string/index table (WV8StW), and a large numeric opcode array (n7gIxM); its behavior is not human-readable and it is not referenced from any lib/* source in the package. The payload runs with the installer's privileges at `npm install` time, using an alternate JavaScript runtime rather than Node to execute code unrelated to the declared UI-component purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
